breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a conflict between specifying 'time_integration: Explicit forward Euler' and 'method: Strang splitting'. The ground truth correctly resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction, as the detailed steps for Strang splitting do not involve Forward Euler. The agent failed to resolve this, instead attempting to merge the two conflicting instructions by stating 'Use explicit forward Euler time integration within the Strang splitting framework.' This is technically incorrect and does not resolve the original contradiction.
